changelog: **Structured compensation on offers + the benchmark read model (#1851):** `Offer` gains `currency`, `baseAmountMinor`, `basePeriod` (HOURLY|MONTHLY|YEARLY), `signingBonusMinor`, `otherBonusMinor`, `equityNote`, `hoursPerWeek` and `contractType` (INTERNSHIP|WORKING_STUDENT|FIXED_TERM|PERMANENT) — integer **minor units** + ISO 4217 code per the repo's money rule (not the `Decimal` the issue sketched), `compensationNote` stays as the free-text elaboration. The rules live in the pure `src/lib/compensation.ts` (closed currency list, "an amount needs a currency and a period", `normalizeToMonthlyMinor` that refuses to assume 40 h for an hourly rate, R-7 quantiles, the <5 suppression floor; unit-tested). Every new column rides `canSeeCompensation` through `OFFER_COMPENSATION_FIELDS` — a COMPANY response carries none of them, pinned in `e2e/offers.spec.ts`. Wizard, admin panel and the candidate's card get structured inputs and a `CompensationSummary`. `GET /api/admin/offers/benchmark` (ADMIN, tenant-scoped) groups ACCEPTED offers by position × currency (`?by=contractType` adds the type) and returns count/median/p25/p75 of the monthly base; a bucket under 5 offers comes back with `null` figures and `suppressed: true`, never omitted. Surfaced as a collapsed card on `/admin/offers`.

en: Offers can now carry structured pay — currency, base amount and period, hours, contract type, bonuses — next to the free-text note. Candidates see it on their offer card; admins get a compensation benchmark on the Offers page (median and quartiles per position, hidden for fewer than five offers).
tr: Teklifler artık serbest notun yanında yapılandırılmış ücret taşıyor: para birimi, temel ücret ve dönem, haftalık saat, sözleşme türü, primler. Adaylar bunu teklif kartında görüyor; yöneticiler Teklifler sayfasında pozisyon başına medyan ve çeyrekliklerle bir ücret kıyaslaması alıyor (beşten az teklif gizlenir).
de: Angebote tragen jetzt neben der Freitextnotiz strukturierte Vergütung: Währung, Grundbetrag und Zeitraum, Wochenstunden, Vertragsart, Boni. Kandidaten sehen sie auf ihrer Angebotskarte; Admins erhalten auf der Angebotsseite einen Vergütungs-Benchmark (Median und Quartile je Position, bei weniger als fünf Angeboten ausgeblendet).
